Likelihood penalty specification

Source: R/likPenalty.R
nlmixr2LikPenaltySpec.Rd

Describes one compiled likelihood penalty (see `vignette("likelihood-penalties", package = "nlmixr2est")`) to apply during a single fit. A model extension attaches specs to a model with [nlmixr2LikPenaltyAdd()]; they can also be passed to `nlmixr2()` as `likPenalty=`.

Usage

nlmixr2LikPenaltySpec(
  ptr,
  thetas = character(0),
  par = numeric(0),
  data = NULL,
  inObjf = NA,
  name = NULL
)

Arguments

ptr

the penalty: an external pointer to a C `nlmixrLikPenalty`, a function returning one (resolved when the fit starts, so the spec survives `saveRDS()`), or the name of a built-in penalty (`"thetaL2"`, `"etaL2"`).

thetas

names of the population parameters the penalty acts on; handed to the C callbacks as 0-based theta indices (`ctx->sel`).

par

numeric settings handed to the C callbacks (`ctx->par`).

data

optional external pointer handed to the C callbacks (`ctx->data`); defaults to the bundle's own `data`.

inObjf

should the penalty be counted in the reported objective function? `NA` uses the bundle's `NLMIXR_PEN_IN_OBJF` flag.

name

label used in `fit$likPenalty`; defaults to the bundle's name.

Value

a `nlmixr2LikPenaltySpec` object

Author

Matthew L. Fidler

Examples

# ridge penalty of 10*tka^2 (on the -2LL scale), shaping the fit only
nlmixr2LikPenaltySpec("thetaL2", thetas = "tka", par = 10)
#> likelihood penalty thetaL2 on tka par: 10 inObjf: NA
